cases.name: primitive annotations
cases.source: function main(): void { const n: number = 1; const s: string = 'x'; const b: boolean = true; console.log(n, s, b); }

cases.name: array literal
cases.source: function main(): void { const values: number[] = [1, 2, 3]; console.log(values.length); }

cases.name: tuple
cases.source: function main(): void { const pair: [string, number] = ['x', 1]; console.log(pair[0]); }

cases.name: object type
cases.source: type User = { name: string; age: number }; function main(): void { const user: User = { name: 'A', age: 1 }; console.log(user.name); }

cases.name: interface
cases.source: interface User { name: string; age: number } function main(): void { const user: User = { name: 'A', age: 1 }; console.log(user.age); }

cases.name: generic function
cases.source: function first<T>(value: T): T { return value; } function main(): void { console.log(first<number>(42)); }

cases.name: two parameter generic
cases.source: function choose<T, U>(left: T, right: U): T { return left; } function main(): void { console.log(choose<number, string>(1, 'x')); }

cases.name: union narrowing
cases.source: function show(value: string | number): string { return typeof value === 'string' ? value : String(value); } function main(): void { console.log(show(1)); }

cases.name: intersection
cases.source: type Named = { name: string }; type Aged = { age: number }; function main(): void { const value: Named & Aged = { name: 'A', age: 1 }; console.log(value.name); }

cases.name: class fields
cases.source: class User { name: string = 'A'; age = 1; label(): string { return this.name; } } function main(): void { console.log(new User().label()); }

cases.name: class inheritance
cases.source: class Base { value: number = 1; } class Child extends Base { next(): number { return this.value + 1; } } function main(): void { console.log(new Child().next()); }

cases.name: enum
cases.source: enum State { Ready, Done } function main(): void { const state: State = State.Done; console.log(state); }

cases.name: optional property
cases.source: type Options = { label?: string }; function read(value: Options): string { return value.label ?? 'none'; } function main(): void { console.log(read({})); }

cases.name: optional chaining
cases.source: type Box = { value: string } | undefined; function read(box: Box): string { return box?.value ?? 'none'; } function main(): void { console.log(read(undefined)); }

cases.name: destructuring
cases.source: function main(): void { const { value, nested: [first] } = { value: 1, nested: [2] }; console.log(value + first); }

cases.name: rest and spread
cases.source: function sum(...values: number[]): number { return values.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0); } function main(): void { const values: number[] = [1, 2]; console.log(sum(...values)); }

cases.name: for of
cases.source: function main(): void { let total: number = 0; for (const value of [1, 2, 3]) total += value; console.log(total); }

cases.name: try catch finally
cases.source: function main(): void { try { throw new Error('x'); } catch (error) { console.log(error); } finally { console.log('done'); } }

cases.name: async await
cases.source: async function value(): Promise<number> { return 42; } async function main(): Promise<void> { console.log(await value()); }

cases.name: promise chain
cases.source: function main(): void { new Promise<number>((resolve) => resolve(1)).then((value) => value + 1).catch(() => 0); }

cases.name: mapped type
cases.source: type Flags<T> = { [K in keyof T]: boolean }; type Input = { ready: number }; function main(): void { const flags: Flags<Input> = { ready: true }; console.log(flags.ready); }

cases.name: keyof indexed access
cases.source: type Item = { name: string; count: number }; function read<T, K extends keyof T>(value: T, key: K): T[K] { return value[key]; } function main(): void { console.log(read<Item, 'name'>({ name: 'A', count: 1 }, 'name')); }

cases.name: conditional type
cases.source: type Result<T> = T extends string ? number : boolean;

cases.name: declaration emit
cases.source: export type Public = { value: string };
